dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, did you get your bag back?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, dɪd juː ˈɡɛt jʊr ˈbæɡ ˈbæk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! Unfortunately, it wasn't on our flight. It was in Osaka.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ʌnˈfɔːrtʃənətli, ɪt ˈwʌzənt ɑːn aʊər ˈflaɪt. ɪt wʌz ɪn oʊˈsɑːkə.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So what did the airline do?
dialogue.reading: soʊ ˈwʌt dɪd ði ˈɛrlaɪn ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Luckily, it came on the next flight, and they brought it to our house.
dialogue.reading: ˈlʌkəli, ɪt ˈkeɪm ɑːn ðə ˈnɛkst ˈflaɪt, ənd ðeɪ ˈbrɔːt ɪt tə aʊər ˈhaʊs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But my dad lost his hat on the bullet train in Japan.
dialogue.reading: bʌt maɪ ˈdæd ˈlɔːst hɪz ˈhæt ɑːn ðə ˈbʊlɪt ˌtreɪn ɪn dʒəˈpæn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh no! Did he find it?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! dɪd hiː ˈfaɪnd ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: He called the station, and after a while, they found it. It was at the lost and found.
dialogue.reading: hiː ˈkɔːld ðə ˈsteɪʃən, ənd ˈæftər ə ˈwaɪl, ðeɪ ˈfaʊnd ɪt. ɪt wʌz ət ðə ˈlɔːst ənd ˈfaʊnd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So did he get it back?
dialogue.reading: soʊ dɪd hiː ˈɡɛt ɪt ˈbæk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! In the end, they mailed it to our house in Bangkok.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ɪn ði ˈɛnd, ðeɪ ˈmeɪld ɪt tə aʊər ˈhaʊs ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.
